verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented adapters or integration guides for the Claude Agent SDK, Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, or CrewAI. What it does show belongs to other stories: an MCP server for MCP clients, raw CDP access for Playwright/Puppeteer, and a generic 'cloud browser for your own agents' positioning. These are developer building blocks or a different story's capability, not framework adapters, so they earn no credit here.
